_template_notes.purpose: Frontend API Client graph — Discovery Plugin #8 (v2.0 Gói C++). Parse React Query hooks (useQuery/useMutation/useInfiniteQuery) + Refit interfaces + raw fetch/axios calls. Source: Grep `apps/erp-web/**/*.{ts,tsx}` cho client-side API consumption patterns. Consumed by lanes CD13 (FE↔BE Contract Sync) + CD38 (UI Implementation Coverage) qua graph_dependency.
populate: nodes[]: 1 entry per API client unit — {id, name, kind, module, file_path, endpoint_method, endpoint_path, fingerprint}
nodes[].endpoint_method: 'GET'|'POST'|'PUT'|'PATCH'|'DELETE' (parsed từ useMutation method hoặc Refit attribute) — null nếu không xác định được
nodes[].endpoint_path: route pattern (e.g. '/api/v1/crm/customers/{id}') — null nếu dynamic
edges[]: 1 entry per client → endpoint call — {from_client, to_endpoint, kind: 'calls', uncertain: boolean}
metadata.parser_version: '1.0' Grep-based; v2.1 → ts-morph AST cho full type extraction
metadata.skipped_files[]: files với parse error (log fail không block)
skip_conditions: Project KHÔNG có apps/erp-web/ → SKIP, write empty graph với skipped:true (per CD13 graph_dependency optional, E137 WARN)
Tech stack frontend != Next.js/React → SKIP (parser v1.0 chỉ support React Query + Refit + window.fetch)
